title: IRIDIA
description: The spatial architecture of kinetic light. The page is an orbital 3D prismatic pavilion with live Navier-Stokes shader gradients, real-time Cauchy dispersion and interactive synthesizer.
stack: Next.js 16 · Tailwind v4 · React 19 · WebGL2 · CSS 3D
